title: For long-term sanity … invest just five minutes and let this song do its work on you.
excerpt: Our current COVID-19 crisis is a symptom of an even deeper crisis. We’ve been living out of sync with reality. Kudos to Extinction Rebellion for making reality a little clearer through this song …
